children: SPORTSMAN'S WAREHOUSE HOLDINGS, INC. reported second-quarter results for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, with revenue of $295.6M, a slight increase from $293.9M a year earlier, and a net loss of $4.4M, an improvement versus a $7.1M loss in the year-ago quarter. Diluted loss per share was $(0.11), compared with $(0.18) in the prior-year quarter.
Revenue was $295.6M for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, versus $293.9M in the year-ago quarter; YoY change 0.6%.
Net income (loss) was a loss of $4.4M for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, versus a loss of $7.1M in the year-ago quarter.
Diluted earnings per share was $(0.11) for the 13 weeks ended Aug 1, 2026, versus $(0.18) in the year-ago quarter.
Net sales rose modestly year-over-year (0.6% for the quarter; 1.6% year-to-date), led primarily by gains in Hunting & Shooting Sports.
E-commerce penetration increased to roughly 19–21% of sales, supporting the company’s omni-channel expansion.
Category strength was concentrated in firearms, ammunition and less-lethal protection; fishing sales were up modestly year-to-date.
Management recorded impairments of $17.8M related to 10 underperforming stores and anticipates approximately five additional store closures as the portfolio is reviewed.
Inventory was down about 10% year-over-year at quarter end, aiding freight cost reduction, margin improvement and in-stock levels on core items.
